missionStatement: Investigate and compare feasible USV-01 concepts for coastal and harbor autonomous patrol; do not assume dimensions, mass, power, range or endurance are approved.

requirements.statement: Prepare independently reviewable alternatives and trace every proposed parameter to a source, a calculation, a stated assumption or TBD.
requirements.source: Project Lead discussion on 2026-11-13; concept process instruction, not final vessel mission specification

requirements.statement: Preserve simulation-only safety boundaries; no vessel actuation or sea-trial authority in the Digital Lab.
